title: Tell of All His Wondrous Works

questions.question: Oh give thanks to the Lord; call upon his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 105:1 (ESV): "Oh give thanks to the Lord; call upon his name;"

questions.question: Make known his deeds among the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 105:1 (ESV): "...make known his deeds among the peoples!"

questions.question: Sing to him, sing praises to him; tell of all his wondrous what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 105:2 (ESV): "...tell of all his wondrous works!"

questions.question: Glory in his holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the Lord do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 105:3 (ESV): "...let the hearts of those who seek the Lord rejoice!"

questions.question: Seek the Lord and his strength; seek his presence how?
questions.explanation: Psalm 105:4 (ESV): "Seek the Lord and his strength; seek his presence continually!"

questions.question: He is the Lord our God; his judgments are in all the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 105:7 (ESV): "He is the Lord our God; his judgments are in all the earth."

questions.question: He remembers his covenant forever, the word that he commanded, for a thousand what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 105:8 (ESV): "...the word that he commanded, for a thousand generations,"

questions.question: The covenant that he made with Abraham, his sworn promise to whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 105:9 (ESV): "the covenant that he made with Abraham, his sworn promise to Isaac,"

questions.question: Which he confirmed to Jacob as a statute, to Israel as an everlasting what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 105:10 (ESV): "...to Israel as an everlasting covenant,"

questions.question: Saying, "To you I will give the land of Canaan as your portion for an what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 105:11 (ESV): "saying, 'To you I will give the land of Canaan as your portion for an inheritance.'"

questions.question: He allowed no one to oppress them; he rebuked kings on their account, saying, "Touch not my what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 105:15 (ESV): "saying, 'Touch not my anointed ones, do my prophets no harm!'"

questions.question: He sent a man ahead of them, Joseph, who was sold as a what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 105:17 (ESV): "...Joseph, who was sold as a slave."

questions.question: He sent Moses his servant, and Aaron, whom he had what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 105:26 (ESV): "He sent Moses his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen."

questions.question: He spread a cloud for a covering, and fire to give light by what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 105:39 (ESV): "He spread a cloud for a covering, and fire to give light by night."

questions.question: He brought out his people with joy, his chosen ones with what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 105:43 (ESV): "So he brought out his people with joy, his chosen ones with singing."

key_verse_text: Seek the Lord and his strength; seek his presence continually!
